title: Divide-and-Conquer Modeling for the CTF-4-Science Lorenz Benchmark
abstract: arXiv:2606.10084v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: This submission documents the divide-and-conquer modeling strategy developed for the CTF-4-Science Lorenz Chaotic Systems Challenge at AI-DEEDS 2026. The challenge uses the CTF-4-Science Lorenz benchmark to evaluate chaotic-system prediction across twelve hidden scores and five scenario families: clean forecasting, noisy reconstruction, noisy-input forecasting, few-shot learning, and parametric generalization. Rather than forcing one model class to handle all regimes, the final system matched each prediction block to the evaluation behavior of its task group. The main contributions are: smoothing-based reconstruction for noisy full-trajectory denoising; NG-RC/NVAR models tuned for noisy long-time attractor forecasting; a fitted Lorenz transition correction restricted to the sensitive clean short-time prefix; and a parametric prefix blend for the interpolation task. translated_title: CTF-4-Science洛伦兹基准的分治建模方法
translated_abstract: 本文记录了为AI-DEEDS 2026会议上的CTF-4-Science洛伦兹混沌系统挑战赛所开发的分治建模策略。该挑战赛使用CTF-4-Science洛伦兹基准，通过十二项隐藏评分和五类场景族来评估混沌系统预测：干净预测、噪声重构、含噪输入预测、小样本学习和参数泛化。与其强迫单一模型类别处理所有情形，最终系统将每个预测块与其任务组的评估行为相匹配。主要贡献包括：用于含噪全轨迹去噪的基于平滑的重构方法；针对含噪长时间吸引子预测进行调优的NG-RC/NVAR模型；仅限于敏感的干净短时前缀的拟合洛伦兹过渡修正；以及针对插值任务的参数化前缀混合。最终系统的公开分数为79.63，表明……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出一种分治建模策略，为CTF-4-Science洛伦兹混沌预测挑战赛的五类场景分别匹配定制化方法（平滑去噪重构、调优的NG-RC/NVAR吸引子预测、洛伦兹过渡修正和参数化前缀混合），最终取得79.63的公开分数。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes a divide-and-conquer modeling strategy that matches each scenario family of the CTF-4-Science Lorenz challenge with a tailored method (smoothing-based denoising, tuned NG-RC/NVAR attractor forecasting, a fitted Lorenz transition correction, and parametric prefix blending), achieving a final public score of 79.63.
